Citizens · EVERFI

Making education costs easier to understand.

Citizens and EVERFI’s higher-education finance course connects financial-aid decisions, borrowing and repayment to practical learner scenarios.

ProjectCIT Pathways
Contribution / source recordConfirm project-specific ownership before turning this into a public case study.

Design approach

  • Course flows connect learning objectives to contextual interactions, including financial-aid and repayment scenarios.
  • Chart revisions place feedback beside the relevant inputs and provide chart-detail tables as another way to read the information.
  • Research and revision artifacts preserve the connection between learner feedback and interface requirements.

Why this work matters

The strongest story is the translation of complex financial information into understandable choices, supported by concrete accessibility specifications.

Reference notes

Original flows, research and chart specifications reviewed. Confirm Sindy’s specific ownership and which revisions shipped; specifications alone do not establish accessibility certification.
